name: team_planning_withdraw_departure
description: Have a person stay in a scenario of a Team Planning plan when a scenario it follows has them leave. Their backfill position stays, linked to nobody. Steps after the scenario, and its alternatives, inherit this unless they set a departure again. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. Keep personal details out: deleting the plan erases the note, forgetting a person does not.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.
